baseline.gap: OP_TRY_SEND packed a 32-bit selector with length, discarding high socket ID bits despite full-width nonreused allocation. Raw memory map/unmap/close cleanup remained in that branch. Captured sender generation/principal still fenced other owners.

implementation.wire: Existing opcodes 6 (immediate TCP/UDP) and 16 (deferred TCP) both require full ID in arg0 and exact 4096-byte CSOCKTX1 page: eight magic bytes, u32 length, four zero reserved bytes, 1..=4080 payload bytes and zero tail. No packed decoder or low-half mask; current tag/opcodes unchanged.
implementation.caller_migration: OwnedSocket::try_send_call prepares caller-sponsored memory. send_all and deferred send_call share frame preparation and 4080-byte bound. tcpclient uses try_send_call. NTP preserves its 48-byte datagram and preparation diagnostics inside the current frame.
implementation.owner: Authenticated receive adopts IncomingMessage once into existing PendingSend. Same complete request, caller backing, read-only mapping, reply authority and Enqueue state. Validate canonical shape before exact full-ID captured-owner lookup, then attempt immediate enqueue once. Mapping/backing release precedes consuming reply authority. No retained immediate waiter.
implementation.errors: Preparation rejection retains complete transaction for reply/disposal. Unstarted mapping/submission rejection follows existing returned Rust owners. Service/accepted timeout or lost observation gives no general replay authority. Existing caller wait/backoff policy is unchanged; no new readiness source.
implementation.scope: Existing C18 family and guard-free service loop. No new root, pin, registry, quota family, recovery custody or physical cleanup/charge-refund proof. General containing destructor/cancellation/reply failure and pressure remain unqualified.
remaining: native legitimate high-ID allocation and map/submission/reply failure or cancellation-race injection
saturated admission/send buffers, all-position flood/protected operator capacity and NIC failure
terminal unstarted socket-close retention without recovery custody
